dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I am Katheryne, the receptionist here at the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: It's my job to assign quests to Mondstadt's adventurers and provide intelligence support.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: The Adventurers' Guild is open for business all year round.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does the Adventurers' Guild do?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: The Adventurers' Guild is an organization that was set up to support all of Teyvat's adventurers, all across the seven nations.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: We provide a platform to help newcomers adjust to the adventurer lifestyle, while also supporting veteran adventurers and allowing them to adventure more freely...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: ...The Guild collates all the complex word-of-mouth information it receives and redistributes it in the form of quests and adventures assigned to adventurers.
